notes.title: Updates from GitHub
notes.summary: Mevedia now gets its updates from GitHub (therealbrott), so every installed copy can update, not only the PC with the updates folder.

items.title: Update source is GitHub
items.text: The Main build now comes from github.com/therealbrott/mevedia-updates and the Beta build from github.com/therealbrott/mevedia-beta-updates. Updates are still signed, so a fake or damaged update is refused. Updates → Update source shows the address.
